query: Government applications will be inventoried and grouped into migration waves.
A secure public cloud landing zone will provide identity, networking, logging and policy guardrails.
Priority systems and databases will be migrated to public cloud IaaS and PaaS.
Selected applications will be refactored to use managed databases and container services.
Following cutover, legacy servers will be decommissioned and cloud costs optimised.
Government applications and data will be moved to public cloud services from commercial cloud providers.
